commit.summary: The one terrain library is now `content/terrain/terrain_library.json`, in the Rust crate's schema (`content/schema/terrain_library.schema.json`). The crate loads it beside the tuning. A field of the wrong type, a colour that isn't hex, or a material that isn't in the library fails the load and names the field (`terrains[0].strata[1].material_id`). `TerrainLibraryDef` and everything in it are filled from that file, and every map's layout shares the one library instead of pointing at a `.tres`.
commit.title: feat(content): the terrain library in the crate's schema (spec 39 step 2b)
